subject: Mathematics
source_note: Concept list follows the chapter structure of the NCERT Class 11 Mathematics textbook (rationalised edition). Descriptions are original summaries, not textbook text.

concepts.name: Sets & Notation
concepts.description: What a set is, roster and set-builder form, empty/finite/infinite sets, subsets and power sets.

concepts.name: Union, Intersection & Complement
concepts.description: Union, intersection, difference and complement of sets, and the laws they obey (including De Morgan's laws).

concepts.name: Venn Diagrams & Counting
concepts.description: Using Venn diagrams to visualise set operations and to solve counting problems with n(A ∪ B) = n(A) + n(B) − n(A ∩ B).

concepts.name: Cartesian Products
concepts.description: Ordered pairs and the Cartesian product A × B; number of elements in A × B.

concepts.name: Relations
concepts.description: A relation as a subset of A × B; domain, codomain and range of a relation.

concepts.name: Functions
concepts.description: Functions as special relations; real functions and their graphs (identity, constant, polynomial, modulus, signum, greatest integer); algebra of functions.

concepts.name: Angles & Radian Measure
concepts.description: Degree and radian measure and converting between them; arc length s = rθ.

concepts.name: Trigonometric Functions
concepts.description: Trigonometric functions of any angle, signs in each quadrant, domains, ranges and graphs.

concepts.name: Sum & Difference Formulae
concepts.description: Trigonometric functions of sums and differences of angles and the identities derived from them (double angle, product to sum).

concepts.name: Complex Numbers
concepts.description: The imaginary unit i, complex numbers a + ib, real and imaginary parts, equality.

concepts.name: Algebra of Complex Numbers
concepts.description: Addition, multiplication, division, conjugate and modulus of complex numbers; powers of i.

concepts.name: Argand Plane & Polar Form
concepts.description: Representing complex numbers on the Argand plane; modulus–argument (polar) form.

concepts.name: Quadratics with Complex Roots
concepts.description: Solving quadratic equations with negative discriminant using complex numbers.

concepts.name: Linear Inequalities
concepts.description: Solving linear inequalities in one variable algebraically and graphically, and representing solutions on the number line.

concepts.name: Fundamental Principle of Counting
concepts.description: Multiplication principle for counting the number of ways a sequence of choices can be made.

concepts.name: Permutations
concepts.description: Arrangements: factorial notation, nPr, permutations with repeated objects.

concepts.name: Combinations
concepts.description: Selections: nCr, its relation to nPr, and standard identities.

concepts.name: Binomial Theorem
concepts.description: Expansion of (a + b)^n for positive integer n, Pascal's triangle, general and middle terms.

concepts.name: Arithmetic Progressions
concepts.description: Sequences and series; nth term and sum of an AP.

concepts.name: Geometric Progressions
concepts.description: nth term and sum of n terms of a GP; infinite GP.

concepts.name: Arithmetic & Geometric Means
concepts.description: Arithmetic mean, geometric mean and the relation A ≥ G.

concepts.name: Slope of a Line
concepts.description: Slope from inclination and two points; parallel and perpendicular lines; angle between lines; collinearity.

concepts.name: Equations of a Line
concepts.description: Point-slope, two-point, slope-intercept and intercept forms; general equation of a line.

concepts.name: Distance of a Point from a Line
concepts.description: Perpendicular distance of a point from a line and distance between parallel lines.

concepts.name: Circles
concepts.description: Conic sections introduction; equation of a circle from centre and radius; general form.

concepts.name: Parabola, Ellipse & Hyperbola
concepts.description: Standard equations, foci, axes, eccentricity and latus rectum of parabola, ellipse and hyperbola.

concepts.name: Three Dimensional Geometry
concepts.description: Coordinate axes and planes in 3D, coordinates of a point, distance formula in space.

concepts.name: Limits
concepts.description: Intuitive idea of a limit, algebra of limits, limits of polynomial, rational and trigonometric functions.

concepts.name: Derivatives
concepts.description: Derivative as a limit; derivatives of polynomial and trigonometric functions; rules for sums, products and quotients.

concepts.name: Measures of Dispersion
concepts.description: Range and mean deviation about the mean and median for ungrouped and grouped data.

concepts.name: Variance & Standard Deviation
concepts.description: Variance and standard deviation of ungrouped and grouped data; comparing variability.

concepts.name: Events & Sample Spaces
concepts.description: Random experiments, outcomes, sample space, types of events and algebra of events.

concepts.name: Axiomatic Probability
concepts.description: Axiomatic approach to probability; probability of equally likely outcomes, 'not', 'or' and 'and' events.
